Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
An anarch with a Blade Clot hits twice an opposing minion with a hand strike, inflicting each time 1 damage.
Can the anarch move 2 clot counters to the opposing minion?

If the opposing minion with 2 clot counters is in torpor and gets rescued, is it right that only 1 clot counter is removed?

A link to Smallpox Griet and additional strikes: www.vekn.net/forum/6-rules-questions/67940-smallpox-griet-and-additional-strikes#68088

Name: Blade Clot
[TR:R]
Cardtype: Action Modifier/Combat
Requires an anarch.
Only usable when this anarch diablerizes a vampire with capacity 7 or more. Put this card in play with 3 clot counters. When an anarch you control inflicts hand or melee weapon damage, you may move a clot counter from this card to the opposing minion. A minion with a clot counter goes to torpor or is burned during his or her untap phase. If an older vampire rescues the vampire, burn the clot counter.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> An anarch with a Blade Clot hits twice an opposing minion with a hand strike, inflicting each time 1 damage.
> Can the anarch move 2 clot counters to the opposing minion?
>
Sure.

> Ankha wrote:
> If the opposing minion with 2 clot counters is in torpor and gets rescued, is it right that only 1 clot counter is removed?
>
Design intent would be that all counters on a vampire with a Blade Clot burn when that vampire is rescued by an older vampire.
